第十七章 厉鬼围杀绝境无生（第1页）
凄厉刺耳的鬼啸撕裂漫天浓雾，震得人耳膜发疼，神魂剧烈震颤。
狂风骤然暴涨，漆黑阴风席卷八方，原本弥漫山间的白雾瞬间被阴气浸染，化作浑浊的灰黑色瘴气。漫天厉鬼在空中盘旋飞舞，形态扭曲各异，有的残缺肢体，有的面目狰狞空洞，一双双灰白无光的鬼眼，死死锁定岩石后方的一人一狐一少女。
阴冷刺骨的鬼气铺天盖地压来，如同冰冷大山镇压在肩头。陈默撑起的灵气屏障瞬间剧烈震颤，屏障表面电光纹路疯狂闪烁，不过数息，灵气屏障便出现密密麻麻的裂纹，濒临破碎。
这类阴魂邪物最为难缠，无实体肉身，寻常灵力攻击只能暂时打散黑影，转瞬之间便可借助周遭煞气重新凝聚。同时阴魂自带噬魂之力，专门侵蚀修士神魂，克制所有低阶修行者，杀伤力极为恐怖。
陈默当机立断，上前一步，将小雪和少女彻底护在自己身后，周身灵力尽数涌动，全力以赴抵挡鬼群攻势。
“紧贴着我，不要离开我身后半步。”
他沉声叮嘱一句，随即抬手拍出数道凌厉灵力掌风，掌风破空而出，正面撞上迎面扑来的厉鬼。黑影被灵力击中，瞬间溃散成一缕缕黑气，可下一秒，周遭阴风一卷，溃散黑气再度重组，厉鬼毫发无损，再度扑杀而来。
越来越多的厉鬼蜂拥而上，鬼爪翻飞，阴气纵横，不断轰击在灵气屏障之上。陈默体内灵力飞速消耗，经脉酸胀发麻，额头渗出细密冷汗，呼吸渐渐急促。他独自一人，想要同时护住身后两人，还要抵挡无穷无尽的鬼潮，根本分身乏术。
身后的少女早已浑身僵硬，脸色惨白如纸。
她能清晰感受到扑面而来的死亡气息，冰冷的鬼气擦过肌肤，带来神魂层面的剧痛。她看向身前奋力抵挡鬼潮、身形逐渐紧绷的少年，心底满是无力。
空有数年苦修，空有想要活下去的执念，可在真正的生死危机面前，她没有任何自保能力，只能成为别人的拖累。
她一辈子都在底层挣扎，省吃俭用，忍辱负重，不敢争抢，不敢作恶，拼尽一切只为活下去。她熬过了资源匮乏的修行岁月，熬过了同门冷眼欺凌，熬过了孤身无依的漫漫长夜，却终究熬不过这场突如其来的鬼潮围杀。
混乱厮杀之间，一道体型远超普通厉鬼、通体漆黑凝练、双目泛着血红幽光的鬼首，悄然绕开正面战场。
它极为狡诈，抓住陈默全力抵挡正面鬼潮、无暇分身的空隙，化作一道极致漆黑的流光，无声无息绕到侧面，带着噬魂灭魄的恐怖阴气，径直抓向毫无防备的少女天灵盖。
速度极快，杀机突兀，根本来不及救援。
陈默余光瞥见黑芒，心神骤惊，想要回身阻拦，可正面数十只厉鬼死死缠住他的身形，凌厉鬼爪封锁他所有退路，半步都无法挪动。

Chapter 17: Fierce ghosts surround and kill Wu Sheng in desperate situation (page 1)
The shrill and piercing ghost screams tore through the thick fog in the sky, causing people's eardrums to ache and their souls to tremble violently.
The wind suddenly surged, and the dark wind swept in all directions. The white mist that originally filled the mountains was instantly soaked by the yin energy, turning into a turbid gray-black miasma. The sky was full of ghosts circling and flying in the air, with various shapes and twists, some with missing limbs, some with ferocious and hollow faces, pairs of gray ghost eyes locked firmly on the person, the fox and the girl behind the rock.
The cold and biting ghost energy pressed down overwhelmingly, like a cold mountain pressing down on your shoulders. The aura barrier that Chen Mo held up trembled violently in an instant, and the electric light patterns on the surface of the barrier flashed crazily. Within a few breaths, dense cracks appeared in the aura barrier and it was on the verge of breaking.
This kind of ghostly evil thing is the most difficult to deal with. It has no physical body. Ordinary spiritual attacks can only temporarily disperse the black shadow, but it can be regrouped in an instant with the help of the surrounding evil energy. At the same time, the Yin Soul has its own soul-eating power, which specializes in eroding the souls of monks and restraining all low-level practitioners. Its lethality is extremely terrifying.
Chen Mo made a prompt decision and took a step forward, completely protecting Xiaoxue and the girl behind him. All his spiritual power surged around him, and he went all out to resist the attack of the ghost group.
"Stay close to me and don't leave even a step behind me."
He warned in a deep voice, and then raised his hand to shoot out several fierce spiritual palm winds. The palm winds shot out of the air and collided head-on with the oncoming fierce ghost. The black shadow was hit by spiritual power and instantly disintegrated into wisps of black energy. But the next second, the surrounding sinister wind swept around, and the disintegrated black energy reorganized again. The evil ghost was unharmed and came to attack again.
More and more evil ghosts swarmed up, their claws flying, their Yin Qi spreading across the sky, constantly bombarding the spiritual energy barrier. The spiritual energy in Chen Mo's body was consumed rapidly, his meridians were sore and numb, fine cold sweat broke out on his forehead, and his breathing gradually became rapid. He was alone, trying to protect the two people behind him at the same time, and also resisting the endless tide of ghosts, and he couldn't do it at all.
The girl behind him was already stiff, and her face was as pale as paper.
She could clearly feel the breath of death coming towards her face, and the cold ghost energy brushed against her skin, causing severe pain at the soul level. She looked at the young man in front of her who was struggling to resist the wave of ghosts, his body gradually tightening, and her heart was full of powerlessness.
Kong You has been practicing hard for several years, and Kong has the obsession to survive, but in the face of a real life and death crisis, she has no ability to protect herself and can only become a drag on others.
She has been struggling at the bottom all her life, scrimping on food and expenses, enduring humiliation and burden, not daring to fight or do evil, and doing her best just to survive. She survived the years of cultivation when resources were scarce, she survived the cold-eyed bullying from her peers, and she survived the long nights of being alone, but in the end she could not survive this sudden wave of ghosts.
In the midst of the chaotic fighting, a ghost head that was far larger than an ordinary ghost, with a dark and condensed body, and a blood-red glow in its eyes, quietly bypassed the frontal battlefield.
It was extremely cunning, seizing the gap where Chen Mo was fully resisting the ghost tide in front of him and flawless clones, and turned into an extremely dark stream of light. It silently circled to the side, carrying a soul-eating and soul-destroying terrifying evil energy, and grabbed straight towards the unsuspecting girl Tianling Gai.
The speed was extremely fast and the murderous intent was sudden, leaving no time for rescue.
Chen Mo caught a glimpse of the black light from the corner of his eye and was frightened. He wanted to turn around and stop him, but dozens of ghosts in front of him clung tightly to his figure. Their sharp ghost claws blocked all his escape routes, making him unable to move even half a step.
